players.product: Turnkey HPC data-center campuses leased to hyperscalers (Barber Lake, Black Pearl, Stingray - Texas) - ex-Bitcoin-mining, now 'Cipher Digital'

quarterly_data.signal: Cipher Digital has executed a second data center lease with Amazon Data Services, Inc. (AWS) for 100 gross MW / 70 IT MW at its Stingray site in Andrews, Texas, 100% pre-leased to AWS to support generative AI and HPC workloads; the investor deck cites ~$2.0Bn of contracted revenue, a 15-year base lease term with three 5-year tenant extension options, a 3.0% annual rent escalator and a triple-net structure. Initial rent is targeted for April 1, 2027 (10 IT MW network hall) and May 1, 2027 (60 IT MW data hall), and Amazon agrees to cover construction cost overruns above $10.5MM per IT MW.
quarterly_data.figure: 70 MW critical IT load (100 gross MW); ~$2.0Bn contracted revenue; 15-year base term + three 5-year extension options; 3.0% annual escalator; rent from April 1, 2027

quarterly_data.signal: The same deck states Cipher is developing a 300 gross MW AI/HPC data center at Black Pearl for AWS (its first Amazon Data Services lease) and a 300 gross MW AI/HPC data center at Barber Lake for Fluidstack/Google, with both construction projects on schedule and tracking towards delivery of initial capacity in September 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Black Pearl 300 gross MW (AWS); Barber Lake 300 gross MW (Fluidstack/Google); initial capacity targeted September 2026
